channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Media Arts, Film & Sound, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Media Arts, Film & Sound, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound residency - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Collar Works: Elizabeth Murray Artist Residency (EMAR) 2027
    https://collarworks.submittable.com/submit/360246/elizabeth-murray-artist-residency-2027
    Collar Works · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · Fully supported: there is no cost to participate for accepted artists. Private bedroom accommodation with shared bathrooms in the farmhouse, 24-hour access to a semi-private studio in the barn that housed Elizabeth Murray's studio, all food provided (dinner cooked and eaten communally), and use of the property including a swimming pool, pond and 77 acres of fields and woods. Accepted artists also receive a USD 500 stipend to use at their discretion towards travel, materials or other associated costs. The Family Residency additionally provides free full-day (9am to 3pm) childcare as a parallel creative residency for children aged 5 to 12, plus a dedicated Kids Art Studio. APPLICATION FEE: USD 35 (the first month of the application period was free; the fee applies from 1 August 2026).

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 6 new Media Arts, Film & Sound residencies - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• NEIU Art + Design Studio Art Residency 2026-2027
    https://form.jotform.com/261044627286156
    Northeastern Illinois University (NEIU), Art + Design Department · deadline Closed 09 Aug 2026 · USD 800 honorarium, plus a semester of full access to NEIU Art + Design facilities specific to the project (Art + Tech, Ceramics, Drawing, Painting, Photography, Printmaking, Sculpture); supplies can be requested with guidance and approval from Studio Area personnel. Visiting Artists may also exhibit in a group exhibition in the NEIU Fine Arts Center Gallery.
  • Wassaic Project 2027 Summer Exhibition Open Call
    https://www.wassaicproject.org/apply/summer-exhibition-faq
    The Wassaic Project · deadline Closed 10 Aug 2026 · A modest honorarium for all accepted artists (part of the organization's effort toward W.A.G.E. certification). Artists creating site-specific installations are also eligible for an Exhibitions Fellowship and a no-fee residency of 1-4 weeks in April or May 2027.
  • The Studios at MASS MoCA Residencies
    https://massmoca.org/studios/
    MASS MoCA (Massachusetts Museum of Contemporary Art) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Provides private 24/7 studio space, furnished housing, and seven communal meals per week. Financial aid is available so artists requesting it typically pay between USD 0 and USD 450 per week, and fully funded fellowships cover all residency fees for up to four weeks. Artists who fully self-fund pay a subsidized rate of USD 650 per week.
  • Farm, Flock and Fiber Artist in Residence
    https://www.awrinkleinthymefarm.com/?page_id=1294
    A Wrinkle in Thyme Farm · deadline 31 Dec 2026 · Modest monthly stipend (around USD 400/month) in exchange for roughly 15 to 20 hours/week of farm work, plus free rustic private housing (solar power, wood stove), shared kitchen, bath and WiFi, community meals and farm-grown food, dedicated solo studio time, and weekly collaboration with resident fiber artist Marty Elkin. USD 25 non-refundable application fee
  • Kala Fellowship Program
    https://www.kala.org/residencies/fellowship-program/
    Kala Art Institute · deadline 01 Mar 2027 · USD 3,000 stipend, 24/7 facility access for 1 to 9 months, 1 month of housing for artists outside the 9 Bay Area counties, a Kala class or workshop, and a group exhibition USD 25 application fee (free if applying December through January 15)
  • Roswell Artist-in-Residence Program
    https://www.rair.org/application-info
    The RAiR Foundation · deadline 15 Mar 2027 · USD 1,100 per month stipend, plus USD 250 per month materials stipend from the Frederick Hammersley Foundation. Includes a private house and a studio with rent, utilities, repairs, and maintenance covered. USD 26.32 application fee
